verdict.rationale: Whether user data can be kept out of AI model training is a fair privacy-posture question for a cloud password manager, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documented AI-training opt-out or no-training commitment. End-to-end encryption and the account-level telemetry toggle are adjacent controls, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
